name.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

release_config.description: The name of the release config whose releaseCompilationResult should be executed. Must be in the format projects/*/locations/*/repositories/*/releaseConfigs/*.
release_config.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

invocation_config.description: Optional. If left unset, a default InvocationConfig will be used. Structure is [documented below](#nested_invocation_config).
invocation_config.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

included_targets.description: Optional. The set of action identifiers to include. Structure is [documented below](#nested_invocation_config_included_targets).
included_targets.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

included_tags.description: Optional. The set of tags to include.
included_tags.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

transitive_dependencies_included.description: Optional. When set to true, transitive dependencies of included actions will be executed.
transitive_dependencies_included.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

transitive_dependents_included.description: Optional. When set to true, transitive dependents of included actions will be executed.
transitive_dependents_included.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

fully_refresh_incremental_tables_enabled.description: Optional. When set to true, any incremental tables will be fully refreshed.
fully_refresh_incremental_tables_enabled.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

service_account.description: Optional. The service account to run workflow invocations under.
service_account.rationale: Service accounts control access permissions and must be properly configured to follow principle of least privilege.

cron_schedule.description: Optional. Optional schedule (in cron format) for automatic creation of compilation results.
cron_schedule.rationale: Automated scheduling can introduce security risks if not properly configured and monitored.

time_zone.description: Optional. Specifies the time zone to be used when interpreting cronSchedule. Must be a time zone name from the time zone database (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones). If left unspecified, the default is UTC.
time_zone.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

region.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

repository.description: A reference to the Dataform repository
repository.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

included_targets.description: The set of action identifiers to include in the workflow.
included_targets.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

database.description: The action's database (Google Cloud project ID).
database.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

schema.description: The action's schema (BigQuery dataset ID), within database.
schema.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.

name.description: The action's name, within database and schema.
name.rationale: This argument does not affect data security, only metadata or operational configuration.
